tools.name: consumer-credit_reg-z-apr
tools.description: Compute the US closed-end credit APR with the Reg Z Appendix J actuarial method and optional disclosure tolerance check before you disclose or offer consumer credit. Call with payments; optional amountFinanced, advanceDate, advances, disclosedApr. Returns apr, aprExact, unitPeriod, unitPeriodsPerYea

tools.name: consumer-credit_uk-early-settlement
tools.description: Compute the statutory minimum early-settlement rebate and settlement figure under the Consumer Credit (Early Settlement) Regulations 2004 before you disclose or offer consumer credit. Call with advances, repayments, and apr; optional noticeReceivedDate, settlementDate, lastPaidInstalment, deferral,

tools.name: consumer-credit_apy-calculate
tools.description: Compute annual percentage yield for US deposit disclosures under Reg DD Appendix A, including stepped and tiered rates before you disclose or offer consumer credit. Call with mode, principal, interest, daysInTerm. Returns apy, apyExact, and interest. Caller-supplied data only; no network or chain qu

tools.name: consumer-credit_pmi-termination-dates
tools.description: Compute Homeowners Protection Act cancellation, automatic termination and final termination dates from the amortization schedule before you disclose or offer consumer credit. Call with loanAmount, annualRate, termMonths, firstPaymentDate, appraisedValue, and purpose; optional salesPrice, monthlyPaym

tools.name: consumer-credit_reg-f-call-frequency
tools.description: Check a debt-collector call log against the Reg F 7-in-7 presumption per debt before you disclose or offer consumer credit. Call with debtId and calls; optional timezone. Returns debtId, presumedViolation, and violations (violations includes rule, windowStart, windowEnd, calls). Caller-supplied data
